title: Spray-dried porcine plasma protein improves the performance of Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) during sea-water transfer
study_system_detail: juvenile Atlantic salmon during freshwater-to-seawater transfer
study_objective: To evaluate whether dietary spray-dried porcine plasma protein improves performance of Atlantic salmon during seawater transfer.
facility_detail: 200-L tanks in a recirculating aquaculture system
temporal_scope: 87-day trial; 17-day freshwater phase and 70-day seawater phase
focal_factor_detail: 5% spray-dried porcine plasma protein (Proglobulin) in diet
study_outcome_detail: feed intake, weight gain, specific growth rate, survival after seawater transfer

title: Identification and characterization of lactic acid bacteria isolated from rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss, Walbaum 1792), with inhibitory activity against Vagococcus salmoninarum and Lactococcus garvieae
study_system_detail: lactic acid bacteria isolated from rainbow trout intestines
study_objective: To identify and characterise lactic acid bacteria from rainbow trout and evaluate their probiotic properties and inhibitory activity against Vagococcus salmoninarum and Lactococcus garvieae.
facility_detail: in vitro assays; oral administration and pathogen challenge in rainbow trout
focal_factor_detail: Vagococcus salmoninarum and Lactococcus garvieae; candidate probiotic LAB
comparison_detail: LAB isolates and probiotic treatments vs controls/pathogen challenge groups
study_outcome_detail: inhibitory activity, probiotic traits, pathogenicity and survival/response after bacterial challenge

title: Piscine orthoreovirus demonstrates high infectivity but low virulence in Atlantic salmon of Pacific Canada
study_system_detail: piscine orthoreovirus infection in Atlantic salmon
study_objective: To investigate PRV infection dynamics and whether PRV from fish with or without HSMI-like heart inflammation induces heart inflammation in Pacific-adapted Atlantic salmon.
focal_factor_detail: piscine orthoreovirus (PRV) source/strain and experimental infection
comparison_detail: PRV sources from fish with vs without HSMI-like inflammation; infected vs control fish; comparison with Norwegian PRV challenge outcomes
study_outcome_detail: viremia, PRV load, heart inflammation, cytokine expression, histopathology

title: Isolation, Functional Characterization and Transmissibility of p3PS10, a Multidrug Resistance Plasmid of the Fish Pathogen Piscirickettsia salmonis
study_system_detail: Piscirickettsia salmonis and multidrug-resistance plasmid p3PS10
study_objective: To isolate, characterise and assess the transmissibility and antimicrobial resistance properties of plasmid p3PS10 from Piscirickettsia salmonis.
facility_detail: bacterial culture and plasmid transfer assays
focal_factor_detail: Piscirickettsia salmonis and multidrug resistance plasmid p3PS10
comparison_detail: plasmid-positive vs plasmid-negative bacterial strains; antimicrobial susceptibility comparisons
study_outcome_detail: plasmid structure, transfer frequency, antimicrobial resistance phenotype and transmissibility

title: The effect of exposure to farmed salmon on piscine orthoreovirus infection and fitness in wild Pacific salmon in British Columbia, Canada
study_system_detail: PRV infection across farmed Atlantic and wild Pacific salmon populations
study_objective: To assess whether PRV infection in wild Pacific salmon is epidemiologically associated with exposure to salmon farms and to examine infection/fitness patterns.
focal_factor_detail: exposure to farmed salmon/salmon farms and PRV infection
comparison_detail: wild salmon from high-, low- and remote exposure regions; wild vs farmed salmon; migration exposure categories
study_outcome_detail: PRV infection prevalence; infection status; fitness/survival-related measures

title: The use of palm oil in aquaculture feeds for salmonid species
study_objective: To review research and knowledge on the use of palm oil in commercial feeds for cold-water salmonid species.
focal_factor_detail: palm oil replacing fish oil in salmonid diets
comparison_detail: palm-oil/vegetable-oil based diets vs fish-oil based diets
study_outcome_detail: growth, feed utilisation, lipid/fatty-acid digestibility, fillet texture/colour

title: Sensing the Limits of Fixed Marine Property Rights in Changing Coastal Ecosystems: Salmon Aquaculture Concessions, Crises, and Governance Challenges in Southern Chile
study_system_detail: marine property-rights and aquaculture concession governance system
study_objective: To examine how fixed marine property rights and salmon aquaculture concessions shape governance, crisis response and adaptive capacity in changing coastal ecosystems.
focal_factor_detail: marine aquaculture concessions and property rights
comparison_detail: pre- and post-crisis governance arrangements and regulatory reforms
study_outcome_detail: governance capacity, regulatory adaptation, property-rights effects, congestion and sector stability

title: Tissue specific expression of antifreeze protein and growth hormone transgenes driven by the ocean pout (Macrozoarces americanus) antifreeze protein OP5a gene promoter in Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar)
study_objective: To evaluate tissue-specific expression of antifreeze protein and growth hormone transgenes driven by the ocean pout OP5a antifreeze protein promoter in Atlantic salmon.
focal_factor_detail: OP5a-AFP and EO-1alpha growth hormone transgenes/promoter constructs
comparison_detail: two transgenic lines/constructs compared for tissue-specific expression
study_outcome_detail: mRNA expression across tissues; relative transgene expression; growth phenotype

title: Effect of Gamma irradiation and frozen storage on microbial quality of Rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) fillet
study_system_detail: farmed rainbow trout fillet as food product
study_objective: To assess the effects of gamma irradiation and frozen storage on the microbial quality of farmed rainbow trout fillets.
focal_factor_detail: gamma irradiation dose and frozen storage duration
comparison_detail: 1, 3 and 5 kGy irradiation vs non-irradiated control; storage over five months
study_outcome_detail: microbial population/counts and microbiological quality of fillets

title: Vaccination improves survival of Baltic salmon (Salmo solar) smolts in delayed release sea ranching (net-pen period)
study_system_detail: hatchery-reared Baltic salmon smolts during sea-ranching net-pen period
study_objective: To assess whether vaccination improves survival of hatchery-reared Baltic salmon smolts during the net-pen period of delayed-release sea ranching.
focal_factor_detail: vaccination against Aeromonas salmonicida, Yersinia ruckeri and Vibrio anguillarum
comparison_detail: intraperitoneal vaccination vs bath vaccination vs untreated control
study_outcome_detail: mortality, relative percentage survival and recapture/tagging outcomes
